name: @ai-matrx/terminal
description: The AI Matrx terminal: xterm 6 with fit, theme, phone-grade touch (momentum scroll, long-press select, copy), a keyboard accessory bar pinned above the on-screen keyboard (Esc, Tab, one-shot and locked Ctrl/Alt, arrows, symbols, paging, paste) and a transport-free handle any PTY can drive. Runs in Next.js, Vite and Electron hosts.
